paragraphs.text: Gribble is a beastie on Duskmourn and friend of Toby .

Gribble is Toby 's loyal and protective beastie companion on the plane of Duskmourn. Gribble is a large, imposing creature with purple fur, a broad, menacing grin full of sharp teeth, and multiple face masks adorning its head. Despite its fearsome appearance, Gribble is deeply affectionate and fiercely protective of Toby. It and Toby live within a tower of stacked buildings, safe from Valgavoth 's spawn.
